fixed_says: Assume three things, namely a condition bundle that the code calls OpenImageCondition (whose sole field is RowT), a statement called BaseChangeIsobaricN, and a statement called RowT, which is Row0b applied to IsRecT and states that for every CM number field E with algebraic closure Ω, prime l, ring isomorphism ι from Qbar l to ℂ, a ≥ 1, π of type CuspSub E a, and χ of type HChar on the maximal real subfield, if (CG.mk π).IsRegAlg and PolarizedPair π χ hold then there exist a group homomorphism r from G E Ω to GL_a(Qbar l), an integer wt, and a function HT of type (E →+* Qbar l) → Multiset ℤ satisfying PropsB. Then the statement VWin holds, which says that for every primitive complex Dirichlet character ψ with nonzero modulus N the window statement VWinAt ψ 401 holds. VWinAt ψ 401 says that for every real eps with 0 < eps < 1/52 and every function e from the reals to the natural numbers with PageN eps x (e x) for all x ≥ 1, there are a real J ≥ 1 and a real X0 such that for every X ≥ X0 and every pair of natural numbers q and d with WinPair eps (X^(1/J)) q d, some real Y with X^(1/J) ≤ Y and Y² ≤ X has VAt ψ eps 401 q d (e x) x for every real x with Y ≤ x ≤ Y².
